summary: Verified iter41 refactor of the Care Home Enquiries overlay into the shared CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay component. Backend curl-tested the new portal endpoint (/api/portal/territory-plus/care-home-enquiries) — returns 3 pins All-time, 0 for 12m/30d (matches spec). Playwright-tested the franchisee portal Territory+ view AND the admin regression on FranchiseeDetailPage. Every acceptance criterion from the review request passes: title = 'My Territory+', toggle label switches, 4 presets render, 12m empty-state shows the 'Try All time' link, All-time preset shows 3 rows with correct postcodes (DT3 4AJ x2, BA21 3ST), row hover applies teal tint, territory map + homes list intact, basic /portal/territory/basic route does NOT render the overlay. Admin regression on Monica's page also passes with identical behaviour (labels differ: 'Show/Hide Care Home Enquiries'). No blocking bugs found.

issues: Two of the three rows are the same enquiry (lisa-marie morgan-edwards, DT3 4AJ, 2021-02-08) with different pin IDs. Backend returns 3 distinct docs so this is a *data* duplication in the seeded enquiries collection (216 total contact_form rows), not a UI bug. Not a blocker but might confuse admins who see the same person listed twice — consider a dedupe step in _contacts_map_impl on (email+postcode+date_added) if this recurs.

action_items: None blocking — feature is functional and matches the acceptance spec.

OPTIONAL: server-side dedupe of care-home enquiry pins on (email, postcode, date_added) so the list doesn't show the same enquiry twice for franchisees who received duplicate contact-form submissions.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice refactor — CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay is a clean render-prop component (~225 LOC) reused by both admin and portal via a single `mode` prop. FranchiseeDetailPage no longer has the inline copy (previous review comment addressed).

The new portal endpoint (/api/portal/territory-plus/care-home-enquiries) delegates to server._contacts_map_impl with the franchisee_id pinned from the auth token — good scoping; a franchisee cannot read enquiries outside their own sectors.

portal_care_home_enquiries wraps _contacts_map_impl in a broad `except Exception` returning 200 with a `{error: ...}` body. Consider re-raising as a 502/500 so the frontend's error branch actually triggers — right now a backend failure silently renders '0 enquiries plotted'.

PortalTerritoryPage gating via `!!modules.territory_plus || isDemo` is correct; verified basic /portal/territory/basic force-omits the overlay while territory_plus=true franchisee sees it on /portal/territory.

success_rate.backend: 100% (endpoint curl-tested for default, 12m, 30d, all-time; also verified access gate)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed acceptance tests pass (portal + admin regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay is now shared at /app/frontend/src/components/territory/CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay.jsx and reused by (a) FranchiseeDetailPage.js and (b) PortalTerritoryPage.jsx (mode='portal'). Same testids used everywhere: care-home-overlay-toggle, care-home-overlay-count, care-home-overlay-preset-30d/12m/custom/all, care-home-overlay-from/-to, care-home-overlay-list, care-home-overlay-row-<id>, care-home-overlay-try-all-time. Portal endpoint: GET /api/portal/territory-plus/care-home-enquiries?date_from=YYYY-MM-DD&date_to=YYYY-MM-DD (auth-scoped to franchisee_id). Login flow: portal login redirects franchisee to /portal, admin to /. Use domcontentloaded (not networkidle) — TerritoryMap keeps the network busy polling.
